title: Add contextual rerank anchor + prioritized soft-fail latch for CI
author: Asha Kumar
release_notes: Adds a contextual rerank anchor probe and a prioritized soft-fail latch for CI to reduce noisy hard failures from transient reranker variance. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We see intermittent CI failures caused by high-variance reranker outputs on long-form prompts that only affect a small cohort of prompts. These failures are noisy and slow down rollouts. This PR introduces a lightweight 'contextual rerank anchor' probe that computes a reranker-stability score per prompt cohort and a 'prioritized soft-fail latch' CI adapter that converts low-severity reranker regressions into annotated soft-fail results (deprioritized but visible) while still blocking high-severity regressions.

Design summary: The probe runs alongside existing smoke probes and performs the following: 1) sample contextual perturbations (suffixes and small paraphrases) for selected cohorts, 2) run the active reranker and generation pipeline in shadow to collect rerank order variance and top-k overlap statistics, 3) compute a stability score normalized by historical cohort baseline. The CI adapter evaluates stability scores against a multi-threshold policy: soft-fail thresholds (annotated, non-blocking) and hard-fail thresholds (blocking). Soft-fail events are prioritized by impact and cohort size; CI will surface an ordered list and attach suggested mitigations (increase sample size, temporary canary, add prompt anchor).

patch_snippets:
+ def compute_topk_overlap(base, perturbed, k=5):
+     base_set = set(base[:k])
+     pert_set = set(perturbed[:k])
+     return len(base_set & pert_set) / k
